summary: This is a Friday Jumu'ah prayer and sermon (khutbah) at the Muslim Community Center of Tucson. The sermon provides a detailed Quranic exegesis (tafsir) of Surah al-Kahf (Chapter 18), specifically focusing on the story of Prophet Musa (Moses) and Al-Khidr. The speaker elaborates on the encounters between these two figures, including the symbolic meeting at the junction of two seas, the miraculous revival of the fish, and the three trials: the damaged ship, the killing of the young boy, and the rebuilt wall. The sermon emphasizes lessons about patience, trusting in divine wisdom, and accepting Allah's decree even when divine actions appear incomprehensible to human understanding.
